channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Acun Medya veteran among sought in high-profile drug probe
item.description: Authorities have issued an arrest warrant for a top executive at Acun Medya as part of a widening narcotics investigation that has ensnared several high-profile media figures and celebrities.

item.title: Türkiye expects 1st Eurofighter jets by end of February
item.description: Türkiye expects the first Eurofighter Typhoon fighter jets it acquired from Qatar to arrive by the end of February, the Turkish Defense Ministry has announced.

item.title: Türkiye probes, slams YPG-linked attack on Turkish flag
item.description: Türkiye's justice and defense ministries launched an investigation into a terrorist YPG-linked attack on the Turkish flag along the Nusaybi-Qamishli border line with Syria, with at least 14 people already detained.

item.title: Sönmez soaks in acclaim on historic Melbourne run
item.description: Emerging Turkish talent Zeynep Sönmez said she had never known an atmosphere like it as she extended her trailblazing Australian Open run on Wednesday in front of an electric crowd.

item.title: Nine athletes to represent Türkiye at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Türkiye will head to the 2026 Winter Olympic Games with nine athletes, competing across ice skating, skiing and para alpine skiing disciplines.

item.title: Parliament speaker urges Muslim states to discuss joint defence mechanism
item.description: Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş said Muslim countries should begin discussing a joint defence mechanism, arguing that rising threats require a collective response rather than piecemeal national efforts.

item.title: Erdoğan tells Brazil’s Lula Türkiye backs all Gaza peace initiatives
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan told Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva that Türkiye considers “all initiatives” aimed at establishing peace in Gaza to be important, according to a statement from Türkiye’s Communications Directorate.

item.title: Israeli strike kills three Gaza journalists
item.description: An Israeli air strike killed three journalists in Gaza on Wednesday, the territory's civil defense agency said, while the military said it struck "suspects" operating a drone.

item.title: Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, six others accept Trump 'Board of Peace' invite: statement
item.description: Saudi Arabia and eight Muslim-majority countries including Gaza mediators Qatar and Türkiye have agreed to join US President Donald Trump's "Board of Peace", the Saudi foreign ministry said on Wednesday.

item.title: US, Syria discuss SDF ceasefire, ISIL detainee transfer
item.description: U.S. Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper spoke by phone with Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa on Jan. 21 to discuss a ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) and cooperation on transferring ISIL detainees, CENTCOM said.
